name: Brain-to-text speech decoding (Stavisky Lab)
description: Supervised the conversion of the data that a real-time brain-to-text speech decoder streams through Redis: the intracortical recordings, threshold crossings, spiking band power, audio, sentence cues, phoneme probabilities and decoded text, with the decoder's clock aligned to the recording system's.
Included widgets for the decoder's word and phoneme error rates and its trial-aligned activity.
